name: Smite the Hidden Evil (Combat)
body:
Your martial training helps you find the hidden evil of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Smite Evil Class Feature, base attack bonus +10

Benefit: When using Power Attack and the Smite Evil, choose one non-humanoid creature type. Treat any creature of that type as Evil Outsiders for the purpose of additional damage. Special: The damage from Power Attack stacks with the damage from Smite Evil.

This feat can be taken more than once. Each time choose another non-humanoid creature type.
